action.command:
cd /workspace/app
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/pnpm-install3.log
setsid nohup pnpm install > /tmp/pnpm-install3.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo "pnpm3 pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace/app
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/pnpm-install3.log
setsid nohup pnpm install > /tmp/pnpm-install3.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo "pnpm3 pid $!"", "summary": "Restart pnpm install with JAVA_HOME"}
